messages:
amy-sales: POC with MediSys failing when clients use corp proxy. Seeing lots of 429 and occasionally ECONNRESET. Started after we increased test concurrency.

amy-sales: logs: 
```
2026-03-19T09:05:12Z ERROR http_client.py 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-19T09:05:12Z ERROR urllib3.connectionpool ReadTimeoutError: Read timed out
2026-03-19T09:05:13Z ERROR proxy.py 407 Proxy Authentication Required
```

dan-support: Sounds like proxy auth (NTLM) + spike in retries. Quick fix: reduce client concurrency and enable connection pooling (pool_block) so sockets are reused not re-created.

nina-secg: They will not allow direct egress. We need to review temporary allowlist + answer security questionnaire. No creds can be shared.

raj-eng: Suggested Python client tweak: set max_connections to 8, pool_block True, enable retries with exponential backoff, and honor proxy auth libs on Windows. Also consider Dedicated sandbox for the POC to lower shared rate-limit impact.

amy-sales: I'll send questionnaire and ask them to try the config changes. Also requesting Dedicated trial quote.

infra-bot: ticket 3290 created (sales/poc) with logs attached.

dan-support: I'll drop a small diagnostic script to capture proxy response headers and timing after lunch. If 407 persists we'll need tcpdump + proxy logs.

(END OF THREAD)
